Trigger_Condition: Employee_Status = Active AND Position_Criticality = Critical AND Latest_Performance_Band IN (Strong, Exceptional) AND existing CatBoost attrition prediction = Yes AND deterministic successor result has no Ready Now successor.
Source_Files: Employee_Profile.csv | Employee_Performance_Summary.csv | Position_Master.csv | Final_Attrition_Dataset_200_Employees.csv | existing successor input datasets
Aggregation_Mode: One case per matching employee; overlapping employee rules are merged into one card.
Suggested_Action: Prioritize a retention discussion and review career or compensation factors while strengthening the succession plan for the critical role.

Trigger_Condition: Exception_Status = Open AND Exception_Type = Filled Position Without Approved Budget AND Severity = Critical.
Aggregation_Mode: All matching positions are grouped into one organization-level case.
Suggested_Action: Obtain the required budget approval or regularize the affected positions in the approved workforce plan.

Trigger_Condition: Vacancy_Status = Currently Open AND Position_Criticality = Critical AND Vacancy_Age_in_Days is greater than the threshold from existing Headcount RULE-004.
Aggregation_Mode: All matching Critical vacancies are grouped into one organization-level case.
Suggested_Action: Escalate the affected critical vacancies and review recruitment or temporary internal coverage with the relevant business leaders.

Trigger_Condition: Exception_Status = Open AND Exception_Type = Long-Open Vacancies AND Severity = Critical.
Aggregation_Mode: All matching department exceptions are grouped into one organization-level case.
Suggested_Action: Prioritize the most affected long-open vacancies and review recruitment bottlenecks or temporary internal coverage.

Trigger_Condition: Employee_Status = Active AND Position_Criticality = Critical AND Performance_Trend = Declining.
Aggregation_Mode: One case per matching employee; if DTE-001 also matches the same employee it is merged as supporting evidence.
Suggested_Action: Review recent performance evidence with the manager and agree focused support or development action; do not make an employment decision automatically.
